chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 507 – Han Li’s Frustrating Void Heaven Cauldron & a Rebellious Wolf Spirit
chapter_meta_description: Han Li can’t open the Void Heaven Cauldron! He tames a new artifact spirit and notices a strange stir on the sea. An episode of calm before the storm.
og_title: What Do You Do When Your God-Tier Treasure Won’t Open?
og_description: Han Li’s latest power-up is a locked box with a bad attitude. Plus, a lazy artifact spirit and the whole ocean is getting nervous.
twitter_title: Han Li vs. A Locked Pot: The Real Battle Begins
twitter_description: Can’t open the treasure? Check. New pet wolf is rude? Check. The whole sea is panicking? That’s a problem.

lore_anchors.definition: The legendary number one secret treasure of the Chaotic Star Sea; a massive ancient cauldron that requires a specific method to open, resisting brute force entirely.
A nascent intelligence sealed within a high-grade magical treasure; a powerful spirit often retains a degree of independence and must be fully refined to be controlled.
A rare spiritual wood whose root fragments can contain and nourish a cultivator’s soul; in this chapter, a small section used to stabilize a Nascent Soul or remnant consciousness.
A legendary liquid created by spiritual springs over millennia; a single drop can instantly restore a cultivator’s entire mana pool.
A sacred material that is naturally lethal to devilish and ghostly entities; even a small arrow made from it is a terrifying trump card against such foes.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Void Heaven Cauldron sealed?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The cauldron likely requires a secret technique or the soul-blood of a specific lineage (like the Blood Jade Spider) to open; simple mana injection doesn’t work for a treasure of this grade.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the silver wolf stronger than the elemental wolves?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, the red and yellow wolves are just elemental projections of the silver wolf’s power. The silver wolf is the true artifact spirit and is significantly stronger but refuses to obey Han Li fully yet.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Han Li in such a hurry?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He needs to retrieve his Gold Devourer Beetles from his cave before the other Nascent Soul cultivators return from the Void Heaven Palace and potentially trace him back to Heavenly Star City.
